sword.description: A sharp blade used for combat and defending against monsters.

shovel.description: Used for digging holes and clearing dirt.

axe.description: A heavy tool used for chopping down trees and gathering wood.

seeds.description: Plant these in tilled soil to grow crops over time.

fishing rod.description: Cast it into bodies of water to catch fish.

watering can.description: Fill with water to keep your planted crops hydrated.

hammer.description: Used for building, upgrading, and repairing structures.

wood.description: A useful natural resource used for building houses

beetroot.description: A vibrant root vegetable grown from seeds, useful for cooking or dyes.

cabbage.description: A leafy green vegetable harvested from dense heads grown in rich soil.

carrot.description: A crunchy, nutrient-rich orange root crop grown underground.

cauliflower.description: A compact white head vegetable surrounded by protective green leaves.

potato.description: A starchy underground tuber harvested from mature farming plants.

pumpkin.description: A large, round orange gourd grown from vines on the farm.

radish.description: A zesty, crisp root vegetable with a quick growth cycle.

wheat.description: A mature grain crop harvested from grown stalks, ready for milling or crafting.
